target: Sun 2006 Conjecture1.2 at k=7 for EVERY group, or an exact counterexample

exact_statement.cosets: pairwise disjoint LEFT cosets; no cover assumption
exact_statement.sharpness: seven cosets of an index7 subgroup

authorization: Existing48-hour owner contract: after a met gate continue exploring more problems in the same slot. No new spending/publication/live-infra permission.

priority_precheck.disposition: No prior k>=7 general-group claim located; bounded search, not novelty

first_obligations: Create only the new sun-coset7 lane, exclusive files/directories; predecessors stay read-only.

Freeze a complete written k7 reduction before counted enumeration. Coprime indices cannot be disjoint; gcd<=6 now allows6, so the disjoint-prime-clique k6 reduction does not carry over. Do NOT assume common index factor6, pairwise-coprime cofactors or a Core6(7) template without proof.
Use accepted Sun(<=6) only at its scopes. Derive any minimality/deletion/prime-incidence statements by hand with all hypotheses. A prior-k7 claim stops science immediately.
Freeze every new rule/representation before any counted search. Prefer a new written structural reduction or exact certificate representation; do not launch a larger brute-force range alone.
No expensive enumeration until parent sees the frozen reduction/rules/finite-coverage contract and grants its explicit bounded experiment GO.
Any candidate must cover every group and every index pattern after proved reductions; otherwise report PARTIAL with the exact missing class.
acceptance: Complete proof of the exact k7 target, or an explicit finite group/coset counterexample independently verified
Parent independently re-derives every bridge and used rule; two separately written exact certificate checkers if computation is load-bearing
Hostile reviews from Codex gpt-6.1-sol and Claude claude-opus-5-5
Post-candidate primary comparison with explicit access limits; no first/novelty claim from misses
No silent weakening to integers, normal subgroups, abelian groups, solvable groups, bounded group order or special index tuples

resources.implementation: standard library; source-hashed compiled helpers allowed only after GO
resources.outputs: small; <=16MiB static writes until fresh resource admission passes
resources.native_or_long_compute_now: NOT_AUTHORIZED: disk unstable; initial written reduction only
resources.launch_rule: fresh free>=12.2e9+projectedgrowth; for>=60min also frozen300smonitor rule; floor12e9continuous
resources.stop_policy: ownedSIGTERM+boundedwait only; neverSIGKILL, subprocess/tooltimeout or hardCPUulimit
resources.TMPDIR: inside new lane for every command; no /tmp; files mode x; dirs exist_ok=False

preservation: No predecessor mutation, overwrites, deletions, commits, pushes, publication, contact, old-engine changes, paid APIs or global config changes. Corrections=new versions; UNKNOWNs preserved.
